svg.text: Proposed band: dashed = planned, solid = sent
Mockup only. Nothing was changed in the plugin.
A. Now: built-in TTL plus two planned extensions
B. You click the link: a dashed bar is added on the right
C. At 4:30 the next block is activated, seconds before the cache expires
D. After the first extension was sent

g.text: Bar length is time (1 px = 2 s). Values are examples from one live session; see the README for what is verified.
